scripts._selftest_coverage_law: ISSUE #75 (2026-08-04). Every scripts/*.mjs that HAS a `selftest` mode must appear in exactly one of the two suites below — a selftest nobody runs is a hypothesis, not a net. Measured at the time of the fix: 59 scripts in scripts/, 56 with a selftest-mode dispatch, 45 already in a suite, 11 in NO suite (course, distiller, learnstate, limits, organism_live_demo, oura_auth, oura_coach, reconcile, sprintsync, teaching_contract, validators). All 11 were RUN GREEN twice before being added: once against the live working tree, once inside a bare-checkout sandbox built from `git ls-files` ONLY (plus the four untracked scripts) to prove they need no gitignored personal state — which is the exact shape the away-day CI runner sees. repo_bundle is the one script with NO selftest mode (deliberately absent — it is a generator). test_coach_v2 and claudegen are invoked BARE (each IS its own selftest); both sit in a suite since 9 Aug 2026 — claudegen sat outside every suite for weeks because the coverage detector only matched a QUOTED selftest string, which claudegen never has. When you add an organ with a selftest, add it here in the same commit. ENFORCED 6 Aug 2026: this rule was prose for two days and the very next commit broke it — audit #107 added rejirah, python_state, widget and context_manifest, all four with selftests, all four in NO suite, i.e. the four organs running the learning loop were the untested ones. They are now in squad:selftest above, and scripts/organism_test.mjs `coverage` asserts the rule mechanically, so the next omission fails a test instead of waiting for an audit.

scripts._audit_suite_law: THE MEASUREMENT ORGANS (12 Aug 2026). The third suite. These are the organs that measure the organism itself — the sandbox and its canaries, the static IR, the runtime tracer, the mutant matrix, the token meter, the temporal/herd model, the front door, and (15 Aug 2026) archive_audit — the 2046 reader rehearsed early, which is here for the same cost reason: its selftest spawns two child processes to prove the independence guard bites from OUTSIDE the process it guards, and its `run` mode walks 34,000 records. They live in their own suite for ONE reason: COST. Several build a full git-ls-files sandbox and run for minutes, and folding them into squad:selftest would make the fast pre-commit glance slow enough that people stop running it. The coverage law in organism_test.mjs holds them to exactly the same standard as every other organ — its SUITE_NAMES const is the single membership record, so an organ here is as covered as one there.

scripts._runner_law: AUDIT 6 Aug 2026. The two suites above are && chains, which makes them FAST-FAIL membership records — good for a pre-commit glance, wrong as the net. Measured: brain.mjs sits at position 16 of 43 in organism:selftest, so one red organ left the 27 AFTER it unrun and unreported, and the suite said 'failed' rather than '27 unverified'. A net whose coverage silently SHRINKS when something breaks is the wrong shape. `npm test` is now the authority: it parses these same two strings (so the lists stay the single membership record) and runs every member INDEPENDENTLY, reporting all of them. Use the chains to fail fast; use `npm test` to know.
